sources.summary: the desk macro packet: closed daily bars + ATR14 for all 14 symbols, 14d calendar, COT (stale), valuation, crypto OI, outcomes
Yahoo Finance 11-26: BTC -21.7% MTD; ~$5.1bn spot-ETF outflows in 30d; stablecoin supply -5.6% ($300bn->$283bn)

FedWatch 11-26: 97.5% probability of +25bp on Dec 9 (93.9% a week ago); Williams: will hike at consecutive meetings if necessary
MT Newswires 11-25 close: S&P -0.3%, Nasdaq -0.6%; 10y 4.87% (-3.6bp) despite hot data; US closed 11-26 Thanksgiving
Benzinga 11-25: gold -35.3% from Jan peak; forced selling to meet margin; central banks bought 321t in Q3 (support)
Liputan6 11-26: gold ~3,550 on hot PCE/GDP; US proposed 20% tariffs on China + measures on 13 partners
11-21: AI-stock selloff forcing gold liquidation; Asian stocks worst week since 2020
